patch.value: Research current Home Assistant 2026.8.1 developer documentation, tagged Core source, frontend client types, and live 2026.7.4 behavior. Implement typed auto-unsubscribing startup observation, capability/schema/help integration, and a setup wizard that emits one valid formatter payload in non-interactive mode while retaining interactive guidance. Keep credentials, endpoints, integration names, timing payloads, and topology outside Git and PM evidence.
Add agent-safe Home Assistant startup readiness intelligence
Complete the stable Core startup-readiness surface with a typed bounded subscribe_bootstrap_integrations command and restore strict machine-readable setup-wizard receipts across every formatter.

Built hassio exposes a typed bounded bootstrap integration observation command with deterministic summaries, validation, auto-unsubscribe cleanup, detailed help, schema, capabilities, and all six output formats; Non-interactive settings wizard stdout is exactly one valid TOON, JSON, JSON-compact, YAML, table, or Markdown receipt and connection failures are represented deterministically without leaking secrets; Isolated setup writes secure settings/auth/data files; live read-only startup acceptance retains only redacted counts, booleans, versions, and field names; Build, typecheck, lint, docstrings, duplication, file-size, ShellCheck, audit, Trivy, PM/changelog, release dry-run, package smoke, help E2E, and exact 100/100/100/100 coverage pass

All 85 PM items and 364 graph edges inspected; duplicate scan and exact semantic searches completed; latest pm-cli and pm-changelog 2026.8.7 confirmed; official Core 2026.8.1 and current developer docs inspected; live Core 2026.7.4 and isolated wizard defect reproduced without persisting private output
Agents and operators can diagnose slow or incomplete startup and bootstrap a secure CLI configuration without raw protocol handling or fragile stdout parsing.
Improves startup observability, CI automation safety, and forward-compatible API completeness while preserving a strict privacy boundary.
A production-ready startup readiness and setup flow with typed contracts, exact tests, complete docs, and hosted review proof.
Core 2026.8.1 exposes one stable core subscription not yet typed by the CLI, and live isolated acceptance found that the mandatory wizard corrupts JSON output with human banners.
